title: perfgate: statistical detection of frontend performance regressions in CI
description: perfgate compares the lab page-load performance (FCP, LCP, TBT, CLS) of two versions of a web application in the same CI job, with interleaved loads and a one-sided Mann–Whitney test with Holm correction and minimum effect margins. The release contains the tool (GitHub Action, GitLab template, Docker image, PR/MR comment, history dashboard), the predeclared experiment protocols and the analysis code. Raw measurements are archived separately from the repository's data branch.
